answer: The cedar counter is kept in harbor and jetty shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1463 identities would post 1776 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
